a.attack: Suppression could conceal a deadline when a task changes section or reference period.
a.response: Compare exact actual context; when uncertain retain the date and keep every field in Details.
a.scoreReason: Winner defines why a field stays visible, preserves uncertain and urgent context, and keeps predictable complete details. Rail placement, native disclosure and accurate single status remain compatible grafts rather than lost proposals.

b.attack: A stable rail can leave duration, date and recurrence equally prominent in its closed summary.
b.response: Borrow exception precedence and omit empty rail space.
b.scoreReason: A stable rail can leave duration, date and recurrence equally prominent in its closed summary.

revisedWinner.mechanism: Suppress only safely redundant metadata; always show overdue/divergent dates and keep labeled Details stable at each scope. Unknown or divergent context remains visible; Details is always explicit. Retain dates when context cannot be proven identical. Use selected reference context, never wall-clock assumptions. Omit only context proven redundant; retain uncertain and overdue dates. Retain uncertain context and make Details a stable local route. Compare exact actual context; when uncertain retain the date and keep every field in Details.
revisedWinner.visible: Completion, title, exceptional dates, exact selected period and active scope/filter context.
revisedWinner.disclosed: All nonexception metadata remains in Detalles; page/section options and summary preserve every statistic and edit action.
revisedWinner.access: 44px nonoverlapping targets, scoped labels, keyboard disclosure, visible focus/return, 320px wrapping and reduced motion.
